title: Cyclic Fueter Theory: Lean 4 Formalization of Selected Results
description:
This software repository contains Lean 4 source files developed in connection with the Cyclic Fueter Theory (CFT) research program. It formalizes selected algebraic and geometric statements involving quaternionic algebra, Fueter-type operators, matrix and spinor constructions, quantum-geometric identities, Cartan-frame calculations, the reduced Einstein–Yang–Mills action and its four-dimensional field equations, distributional junction conditions, characteristic evolution and constraint propagation, zero-mode calculations, and consequences of the action principle for the Einstein–Yang–Mills dumbbell (caps as closed radiation universes, the AdS₂ × S² neck, JT/Schwarzian reduction, thermodynamics, stability, the shape and junction of the dumbbell, a reduced action with canonical constraints and a Wheeler–DeWitt equation for the spherically symmetric sector, and a two-dimensional Dirac field).

Version 0.6.0 contains 1873 theorem declarations in 171 modules, with no sorry and no project-specific axioms, plus 556 index aliases. New in this version: real-function proofs replacing earlier hypotheses that were vacuous; the residual gauge algebra sl(2,ℝ) of the conformal frame and the rigidity of the conformally flat sector; a shape theorem for the dumbbell (time-symmetric conformally flat slices satisfy r′² ≤ W², the saturating case obeys r² + ℓ²r′² = ℓ², the cap is the regular solution and the neck the singular solution, so the junction is C¹ and never C²); one reduced action for the spherically symmetric Einstein–Yang–Mills–Dirac sector with its field equations, the mass form of the constraints, a Wheeler–DeWitt equation that reduces to the Friedmann constraint on the cap and to a two-dimensional Klein–Gordon equation on the neck side, and checks of known limits (Birkhoff, Reissner–Nordström, JT gravity, first and second laws, temperature from smoothness); a Dirac zero mode on the cap and the spectrum E² = k² − 1 of the reduced problem; relations between fixed volume, fixed area and the shape degrees of freedom; and conditions related to the weak gravity conjecture (a window 3/4 ≤ (m_W ℓ)² ≤ 1 and Λ ≤ g²/(16πG) for the neck). Negative results are recorded as such. The general solution of the Wheeler–DeWitt equation with matter is not obtained. The additions since v0.5.0 were not audited by an independent reviewer. The repository includes an author-maintained status ledger of 182 items in α-I–α-XV (103 complete, 67 complete using a named external theorem or literature, 9 complete in a differential field pending a bridge to real functions, 0 partial, 3 not started). These labels describe the current scope of this formalization; they are not independent certification or peer review of the corresponding research claims. Numerical results quoted in the ledger are not verified by Lean, and results taken from the literature are marked as external. Lean verifies each theorem from its declared assumptions and imported results. Formalization does not by itself establish that a physical model, external theorem, or interpretation is appropriate.

The project targets Lean 4.15.0 and Mathlib v4.15.0. To reproduce the build, install Elan and run `lake update`, `lake exe cache get`, and `lake build` from the repository root.
